_comment: Illuminated Bestiary, stage 1 (Agent #4): one 96x96 emblem per Codex CATEGORY, wired into the .ref-category-title rows in index.html (32px display = crisp 3:1 integer downscale). Transparent PNGs so they sit on both themes. Run: node tools/generate-assets.mjs --manifest tools/bestiary.manifest.json [--force] [name...]
